Detail: Loaded the fixed public real-measurement analysis set: N=503, cows=30.
Every reported prediction is for an original outer held-out row; no augmented or simulated rows are evaluated.
For each outer fold, source-level alpha/config choices are selected from inner OOF predictions generated only inside the outer-training rows.
Nearest-neighbour memory predictions search only the current training split; the outer test Rectal value is never read.
The method learns separate per-source MetaFusion-versus-memory weights for S01, S03, and S04 inside each outer-training fold.
Training-feature match counts are reported in the accompanying prediction table.
